'''Pons Lo'''<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|136|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: A Night at the Outlander Club}}</ref> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Episode II" /> [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]]<ref name="BigSpenders">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/09/imageattack20020916.html|series=Image Attack|text=Big Spenders}}</ref> who was present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Episode II" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> They were inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were chasing [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Lo wore dark robes and a small hood that still left their entire face visible.<ref name="Episode II" />
